text:
jamie: FYI billing alert - noticed an unexpected outbound egress charge from our model buckets for 2026-02-03. Console shows ~1.8TB transferred out of models-prod -> us-west-2, ~$11.7k for the day. Not normal for this workload.

maria: Ugh. Which prefix? any replication rules recently changed?

jamie: Looks like `models-prod/v2/` is the biggest offender. Billing line item: `Network Egress: us-east-1 -> us-west-2` with object prefix. I grabbed a small listing:

```
$ aws s3 ls s3://models-prod/v2/ --recursive --summarize | tail -n 5
2026-02-03 04:12:17 1258291200 model_v2_20260203.tar.gz
2026-02-03 04:18:02 1258291200 model_v2_patch_01.tar.gz
Total Objects: 24
Total Size: 1.9 TB
```

ryan: Did we enable cross-region replication or did some job start pushing artifacts for backup? The replication config for `models-prod` was set months ago, but no heavy pushes historically.

alexa: I pulled object creation logs from the ingestion service. There are repeated retries from `artifact-backup` between 04:00-06:00 UTC, every ~5m. Each attempt re-uploaded the same archive with a new temp key then copies it over. Snippet: 

```
[2026-02-03T04:00:12Z] artifact-backup INFO start upload model_v2_20260203.tar.gz size=1.2GB attempt=1
[2026-02-03T04:05:12Z] artifact-backup WARN upload failed EADDRINUSE retrying
[2026-02-03T04:10:12Z] artifact-backup INFO start upload model_v2_20260203.tar.gz size=1.2GB attempt=2
```

maria: That EADDRINUSE in the client — maybe a transient networking bug caused the client to not detect success and retry, resulting in full re-uploads being replicated. Good find. Opening a ticket with Cloud support for potential billing credit (CS-987654).

ben: tagging finance: @ben. We need the invoice lines + estimated recovery if support gives credit. Please include the object list.

jamie: Mitigation applied: disabled CRR rule for `models-prod` at 04:40 UTC and added stricter checks in `artifact-backup` so it verifies object MD5 before retry. Also started a cleanup job to dedupe duplicated objects and remove stale temp keys.

deploy-bot: Rollout halted: artifact-backup v3.4.2 -> v3.4.3 (paused by jamie).

sre-bot: Note: created incident INC-20260203-01 for unplanned egress and mitigation steps.

ryan: Next steps: (1) maria to follow up with cloud support for billing adjustment, include invoice id + object manifest. (2) alexa to push fix for retry logic and add idempotency tokens. (3) jamie to run dedupe and report reclaimed bytes. (4) finance/ben to track cost impact on this sprint.

maria: Estimated reclaimable credit request ~ $9k (support dependent). Will update when they respond.

jamie: I'll post the cleanup results once the dedupe job finishes (~2h). Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
